### League
- Teams: 16
- Divisions (4): Northwest, Southwest, Central, East
- Season: NFL weeks 1–17; regular season ends after week 14
- Head-to-head matchups: yes
- Standings order: pct, then h2h, then divpct, then all play pct, then pts, then pwr, then victory points, then opp pts
- Each NFL player can be rostered once in the whole league

### Rosters and lineups
- Roster size: 22
- Injured reserve slots: 50
- Taxi squad slots: 3
- Roster limits by position: QB 0, RB 0, WR 0, TE 0, PK 0, Def 0
- Starters: 9 per week — QB 1, RB 1–4, WR 1–4, TE 1–4, PK 1, Def 1
- Partial lineups allowed: no

### Waivers and trades
- Waivers: blind bidding (FAAB), then first-come first-served once bidding closes
- Minimum bid increment: $25000
- Conditional bids: allowed
- Tied bids broken by: sort
- Waiver rounds per run: 4
- Trade offers expire after 7 days by default

### Draft and keepers
- Draft type: email
- Draft player pool: Rookie
- Time per pick: 12:00 (hours:minutes)
- Keepers: dynasty
- Salaries / contracts: yes
